title: Topological Carbon Quantum Rings With Near‐Unity Photoluminescence for Efficient Sky‐Blue Electroluminescence
title_zh: 具有近乎一致的光致发光的拓扑碳量子环可实现高效的天蓝色电致发光

title: Four superconducting cables link two large quantum processors into one
title_zh: 四根超导电缆将两个大型量子处理器连接成一个
summary: 随着量子计算机变得越来越雄心勃勃，许多研究人员认为，最好的方法是将其构建为多个互连的部分。在这些模块化设计中，单独的量子处理器相互连接，因此它们可以作为一台更大的机器一起工作。然而，要实现这一点，连接必须携带脆弱的量子信息而不破坏它。
abstract: As quantum computers grow more ambitious, many researchers believe the best way forward is to build them in multiple interconnected parts. In these modular designs, separate quantum processors are linked so they can work together as one larger machine. For this to happen, however, connections must carry fragile quantum information without destroying it.
